name: clawd
description: The versioned Musebook Clawd skill bundle packaged for plugin-compatible agents.

interface.longDescription: The preserved Clawd 3.15.1 archive with 272 installable skills plus a Musebook updates workflow for agents, Metaplex assets and launches, NFTs, claims, Town, prediction research and typed coin decisions. Includes source checksums, third-party notices and a feature/API guide. Some skills require separately installed tools or credentials and may perform consequential actions after approval. This full developer bundle is not the separate read-only research submission. Installation does not run scripts, grant wallet authority or enable autonomous trading.
defaultPrompt: Find a Clawd skill for my task and list its prerequisites.
Help me connect an agent to Musebook without exposing credentials.
